scope: Authenticated explicit withdrawal cancels unfinished backend-managed tournaments
checks: Authenticated departure after elimination or a completed final preserves all seven actual results and never cancels the finished managed tournament

Managed PLAYING decline retires all eight live party searches atomically; native event-2012 is delivered once even with live updates disabled, and stale readiness/accept/result/registration cannot resurrect the competition

Managed PLAYING leave retires an allocated lobby and all eight live party searches atomically; native event-2012 is delivered once even with live updates disabled, and stale readiness/accept/result/registration cannot resurrect the competition

Withdrawal validates complete retirement/terminal snapshots, preserves enrollment on malformed source, recovers a blocked terminal write with owned retry, preserves actual results and winning searches after elimination, retains terminal audit data after peer leave, and never interprets a temporary same-session disconnect as cancellation
